$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (sources-developer-overheid). Seeds gitlab-raw, public files on https://gitlab.com, the gitlab.com counterpart of github-raw. Opencatalogi's publiccode-developer-overheid-harvest flow reads each listed repository's publiccode.yml through it at /{namespace}/{project}/-/raw/{ref}/{path}; read it with the source-call option decode: yaml. Credential-free and enabled: it reads only public files and holds nothing secret. A private or missing project answers with a redirect to the sign-in page or a 404, and the flow drops the item. Its own fragment because GitLab is not part of the developer.overheid.nl register. See openspec/changes/sources-developer-overheid/design.md D2.

objects.name: GitLab raw files
objects.description: Reads public files from gitlab.com projects, such as publiccode.yml, at /{namespace}/{project}/-/raw/{ref}/{path}. Needs no account.
